npcs.name: Marla
npcs.dialog: Welcome to Brasshollow General. Steam-fresh stock, fair prices.
dialogs: Word is the mine's gone strange again. Take a lamp. And a sword.
Berries, potions, tools — everything a wanderer forgets to pack.

npcs.name: Elder Bran
npcs.dialog: The March grows wilder by the season, traveler. We could use your blade.
dialogs: Four continents, one crown, and a hundred old wounds. That is Aldermere.
When you are ready for larger deeds, the King himself will want to see you.

npcs.name: King Aldric
npcs.dialog: Rise. Aldermere has few heroes left; I will not waste one on ceremony.
dialogs: The war machines we buried are waking. The Storm Warden worst among them.
My writ opens doors in Gearford. Dwarves respect paper almost as much as iron.

npcs.name: Captain Edda
npcs.dialog: Castle guard's stretched thin. The roads aren't what they were.
dialogs: Wolves on the east road again. My recruits won't cut it.

npcs.name: Portmaster Wick
npcs.dialog: Fine hulls, fair winds. A sailboat hugs the coast; a ship crosses anything wet.
dialogs: Press V near the water's edge to launch whatever you've bought.

npcs.name: Thane Bruni
npcs.dialog: Hmph. Surface-folk. Speak quick, the forge won't stoke itself.
dialogs: Emberdeep runs hotter than it should. Something below stokes it.
A king's writ, eh? Then Gearford owes you a hearing — and maybe a machine.

npcs.name: Smelter Vora
npcs.dialog: Grand forge of Gearford. If it can be smelted, we smelt it.
dialogs: Bring ore. Leave rich. That's the whole economy, friend.

npcs.name: Portmaster Grum
npcs.dialog: Cold water, colder wind. Boats still float, mind.

npcs.name: Archdruid Liriel
npcs.dialog: Sylvas remembers older names than Aldermere. Tread gently, cousin.
dialogs: The swamp lights lure travelers from the road. They are not lights.
The crypt beneath the marsh was sealed for a reason. Reasons rot.

npcs.name: Fenn
npcs.dialog: Elven fletching, forest remedies, and no questions asked.

npcs.name: Portmaster Lys
npcs.dialog: The river takes canoes; the gray water takes better boats.

npcs.name: Matriarch Poppy
npcs.dialog: Willowick welcomes you! Mind the scorpions, dear. And the tower. And the wind.
dialogs: The Spire hums at night. Gnomish ears are too good, sometimes.
Whoever quiets that tower eats free at my table forever.

npcs.name: Tinker Zizzle
npcs.dialog: Gadgets! Tonics! Slightly singed maps! Everything a desert needs!

npcs.name: Portmaster Dot
npcs.dialog: Smallest port on Miradel! Also the only one. Boats out back.
